title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
title_zh: 基于层次化树状索引器的亚二次复杂度注意力

paragraphs.en: 提出ZHA层次化树状索引注意力，实现亚二次复杂度扩展，经短暂KL蒸馏即可低成本应用于预训练模型。 The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 提出ZHA层次化树状索引注意力，实现亚二次复杂度扩展，经短暂KL蒸馏即可低成本应用于预训练模型。注意力的二次方扩展是限制大语言模型（LLMs）长上下文能力的根本瓶颈。 各种方法都曾试图规避这一问题，但它们要么无法匹配注意力的表达能力（例如滑动窗口或具有固定大小状态的线性注意力变体），要么只能实现常数倍的速度提升（例如稀疏注意力方法，其索引器本身仍呈二次方扩展）。 在本文中，我们基于一个层次化的树状结构索引器，推导出一种渐近亚二次复杂度的稀疏注意力方法，称之为 Zyphra 层次化注意力（ZHA）。 ZHA 在KV缓存上构建一棵递归压缩的键摘要树，未来的查询从树顶向下遍历，以检索键的一个稀疏子集。 关键在于，通过迭代地增加树的深度，包括路由和最终注意力在内的总成本随序列长度呈亚线性增长，从而使注意力整体呈现亚二次（但超线性）的扩展。 我们证明，ZHA 可以低成本地应用于现有的预训练模型，只需在数十亿词元上进行短暂的KL蒸馏训练阶段，并且在长上下文检索以及具有挑战性的推理、数学和智能体编程评测任务上保持性能。 此外，我们证明该方法对树形几何结构具有高度鲁棒性，包括多达6层极深的树。 最后，我们建立了一个详细的性能模型，并证明我们的方法呈亚二次扩展，在超过100万上下文时显著优于竞争方法，并最终有望将有效上下文窗口扩展到数亿甚至数十亿词元。
